competitionDesign.antiLuckPrinciple: Raw win-loss ROI over <50 games is ~85% variance. Strategies are ranked primarily on Out-of-Sample Closing Line Value (CLV) and Proper Scoring Rule calibration (Brier / Log-Loss), gated by Benjamini-Hochberg multiple-testing FDR control.

rewardTiers.eligibility: Any newly submitted or unvalidated strategy (<7 gates passed)
rewardTiers.computeAndDataReward: Baseline public NFL.com + Operations feed access
rewardTiers.demotionTrigger: Remains quarantined until Gates G1-G7 all pass out-of-sample

rewardTiers.eligibility: Passes all Gates G1-G7; n >= 200 (Singles) or >= 150 (Parlays/Props); OOS CLV t-stat >= 2.0
rewardTiers.computeAndDataReward: 1.0x research budget + automated pre-kickoff injury diff alerts
rewardTiers.demotionTrigger: Rolling 100-bet CLV drops below 0.0% or calibration p < 0.05

rewardTiers.eligibility: Passes G1-G7; OOS CLV >= +1.5%; Brier Skill Score >= +0.020; FDR q-value < 0.05
rewardTiers.computeAndDataReward: 1.5x capital pool weight + priority line-shopping execution slot
rewardTiers.demotionTrigger: Drawdown exceeds 95th-pct bootstrap envelope or 75-bet CLV < +0.25%

rewardTiers.eligibility: Multi-season walk-forward stability (>=2 seasons); CLV t-stat >= 3.0; positive edge across >=3 bookmakers
rewardTiers.computeAndDataReward: 2.5x capital pool share + highest execution priority + syndicate fee bonus
rewardTiers.demotionTrigger: Regime-shift structural break (e.g. NFL rule change) or rolling CLV < +0.75%

validationGates.name: Point-in-Time Leakage & Pre-Registration Audit
validationGates.threshold: Zero post-kickoff data leakage; immutable git commit hash before OOS window
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: Eliminates look-ahead bias (e.g. using final Sunday status on Wednesday opening lines) and hindsight parameter tuning.

validationGates.name: Minimum Independent Effective Sample Size (n_eff)
validationGates.threshold: n_eff >= 200 single bets; >= 150 parlay/prop tickets adjusted for intra-week correlation
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: At -110 odds, n=30 has +/-17.9% 95% win-rate noise; n>=200 shrinks standard error to <=3.5%.

validationGates.name: Walk-Forward Out-of-Sample Proper Scoring (Brier & Log-Loss)
validationGates.threshold: OOS Brier Score & Log-Loss strictly beat vig-stripped closing market baseline
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: Evaluates probability calibration on every play rather than noisy binary 0/1 fumble/overtime outcomes.

validationGates.name: Closing Line Value (CLV) Skill Gate
validationGates.threshold: Mean vig-free CLV > +1.0% with one-sided t-stat >= 2.0 (p <= 0.023)
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: Closing NFL lines aggregate sharp syndicate information; beating the close proves genuine price-discovery skill.

validationGates.name: Multiple-Testing & Data-Snooping Control (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR)
validationGates.threshold: FDR-adjusted q-value <= 0.05 across all N candidate strategies tested on the board
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: Testing 50 random strategies yields ~2.5 false 'winners' at p<0.05 by pure luck; FDR penalizes strategy mining.

validationGates.name: Joint Correlation & SGP Vig-Tax Verification
validationGates.threshold: Empirical copula/Pearson r estimated OOS; ticket EV > +3.0% over correlated joint fair probability
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: Prevents double-counting correlated legs (CORR-10 / CORR-11) or paying hidden sportsbook SGP correlation markups.

validationGates.name: Regime Stability & Bootstrap Drawdown Stress Gate
validationGates.threshold: Positive CLV in both halves of season, indoor/outdoor, and 95th-pct 10,000-run bootstrap max DD < 20%
validationGates.luckRemovalMechanism: Rejects fragile strategies driven by a single outlier week, team, or weather freak event.
